_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

billOfProcessId.description: Reference to u_mes_prod_billOfProcess._id: the parent document this one belongs to

billOfProcessName.description: Display value of billOfProcessId, copied from u_mes_prod_billOfProcess.recordNo

stepNo.description: Step number within the parent record

operationName.description: Display value of operationId, copied from u_mes_prod_operation.name

recipeName.description: Display value of recipeId, copied from u_mes_prod_recipe.name

workInstructionName.description: Display value of workInstructionId, copied from u_mes_prod_workInstruction.title

inspectionPlanName.description: Display value of inspectionPlanId, copied from u_mes_qual_inspectionPlan.name

manning.description: Manning of the bill of process step

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
